item.title: Combined barrage from Iran and Lebanon strikes central, northern Israel; Impact at Bazan oil refinery complex in Haifa area
item.description: Police, Magen David Adom and fire and rescue teams deployed to multiple sites in northern Israel following the combined fire from Iran and Lebanon, with initial reports indicating damage only and no bodily injuries

item.title: 'Anything linked to Hezbollah is demolished': IDF special forces deep in Lebanon
item.description: Trained in dense urban warfare, the IDF’s counterterror unit — which prepares elite forces — is now operating at the deepest point of Israeli activity in southern Lebanon, where its commander says its ladders are a 'game changer' for rapid movement across rugged terrain.

item.title: US professor living in Israel: what Americans see online about Iran war is 'not reality'
item.description: Fulbright scholar Jennifer Murtazashvili, who moved with her family to Israel, says daily life remains largely normal despite rocket fire and that many viral videos abroad are fake or misleading

item.title: Netanyahu says ‘Hezbollah is not the same,’ orders expanded buffer zone in Lebanon

item.title: Israel faces pressure to end Iran strikes as US pushes ceasefire-for-talks option
